skill.name: Traefik
skill.description: Avoid common Traefik mistakes — router priority, TLS configuration, Docker labels syntax, and middleware ordering.
skill.summary: Router Basics - Router must have `rule` AND `service` — missing either = not working - Rule priority: longer rules win by default — explicit `priority` to override - `Host()` is case-insensitive — `Host(\`example.com\`)`
